metadata.description: Dreamina Seedance 2.5 generates native 30-second single-shot video at up to 720p from a single text prompt, reasoning about the whole shot at once so motion, lighting, and subject identity stay coherent from first frame to last.

info.title: Queue OpenAPI for fal-ai/seedance-2.5/text-to-video
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the fal-ai/seedance-2.5/text-to-video queue.

end_user_id.description: The unique user ID of the end user.
end_user_id.title: End User Id

aspect_ratio.description: The aspect ratio of the generated video. Use 16:9 for landscape, 9:16 for portrait/vertical, 1:1 for square, 21:9 for ultrawide cinematic, or auto to let the model decide.
aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio

examples: An octopus finds a football in the ocean and excitedly calls its octopus friends to come and play. Cut scene to an octopus football game under the sea.
prompt.description: The text prompt used to generate the video
prompt.title: Prompt

bitrate_mode.description: Output bitrate mode. 'high' requests a higher-quality, larger-file encode from the model; 'standard' uses the default bitrate.
bitrate_mode.title: Bitrate Mode

duration.description: Duration of the video in seconds. Supports 4 to 30 seconds, or auto to let the model decide based on the prompt.
duration.title: Duration

generate_audio.description: Whether to generate synchronized audio for the video, including sound effects, ambient sounds, and lip-synced speech. The cost of video generation is the same regardless of whether audio is generated or not.
generate_audio.title: Generate Audio

resolution.description: Video resolution - 480p for faster generation, 720p for balance, 1080p for high quality.
resolution.title: Resolution

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
